asset: shared mature painterly native actor surface family
prompt: Create a reusable BASE-COLOR MATERIAL ATLAS for native 3D characters in Guardians of Nature. The attached image is the ACTUAL USER APPROVED GAME REFERENCE: match its mature restrained painterly woodland fantasy genre, rich subtle designed material texture, comparable to Diablo Immortal, NOT photoreal, NOT pastel/cute, NOT toy plastic. This is surface material production, NOT a game screenshot or character concept. Exact canvas 1536x1024, six equal SQUARE tiles in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows grid, each 512x512, no margins/gaps/borders/labels. Order top row LEFT TO RIGHT: light-neutral woven matte CLOTH, light-neutral fine-grain LEATHER, light-neutral weathered forged IRON. Bottom row LEFT TO RIGHT: light-neutral soft SKIN surface, light-neutral organic HAIR/FUR strand surface, light-neutral weathered natural ROCK. Every tile is FLAT FRONT-ON ORTHOGRAPHIC, uniform neutral diffuse lighting, very light warm gray/off-white base (around RGB 200-230) so game vertex-color tints can supply navy cloth, brown leather, skin tones and dark hair without becoming double-dark. Gentle mid-frequency painterly material variation: cloth has irregular woven cross-thread detail; leather has restrained organic grain and creases; iron has broad subtle hand-forged texture with NO reflected highlight; skin has soft understated painted microtexture NO face, pores macrophoto or wrinkles; hair/fur has designed flowing fine strand groups with NO hairstyle or creature; rock has subtle granular fracture texture NO separate stone objects. Each tile should repeat on all edges, continuous material sampling, no tile edges or seams. Albedo ONLY: no baked cast shadows, no directional sun patch, no specular hot spots, no ambient-occlusion cavities, no painted object lighting, no normal-map or roughness-map colors. No faces, people, costumes, bones, weapons, objects, scenery, perspective, isometric view, UI, lettering or ornaments. Preserve the visual sophistication of the reference while remaining clearly a production material sheet.
